address: Plaza de San Juan 3, Olaberria, 20212, Spain
bio: The duo of Ugutz Rubio in the kitchen and his sister Izaro overseeing the front of house have taken over the reins of this beautiful large property in the centre of Olaberria, which is also known as the Balcony of the Goierri region. The traditional Basque cuisine served here features excellent grilled fish and meats, including specialities that you won’t want to pass up on, such as peppers stuffed with cod and the famous mushrooms baked in the oven....
